question: Where and with what mental state should one meditate on the goddess?
premises: Meditation on the goddess is prescribed.
The locus of meditation is the body-seat.
The practitioner should have a very steady mind.
inference: Therefore one should meditate on the goddess in the body-seat with a very steady mind.
plain_english: Then, with a very steady mind, one should meditate on the goddess in the seat of the body.
